gpt.rationale: Aoi’s many happy/grinning sprites suit an outgoing, expressive girl who jokes through stress, but several beats are off—especially happiness on the wrong-classroom embarrassment and self-mocking line where blush/awkwardness would fit better.

claude.rationale: Expressive choices fit the extroverted personality, but the embarrassed wrong-classroom lines and the self-mocking 'Absolute master class' line are flatly tagged happiness rather than embarrassment/sheepishness, and 'anger' for the map line is closer than the surrounding misses.
